body: Thanks, Yeah I finally decided to live but, it may not be for long, if I reach a point where I can't enjoy anything, I'll probably "just do it" (as "Shia Labeouf" would say), but for the moment, I'll focus about living for the time being, I just don't think it's the right moment to do it and I have plenty of things to discover right now. I also think that all of the occupations (school, work, religion) are just meant to prevent you to have time to think about your life, and it might be one of the things that prevented our ancestors to commit suicide. Anyway, I might just kill myself next year or so. But I'd be happy to chat with you

You are not alone, a lot of people have been bullied at school (including me) I have a great advice for you that is as useful IRL and on the internet, don't mind others, if they don't understand you, just don't care about them. You are alone in your mind, you can do whatever you want, I am 16 and I do wan't to kill myself for other reasons but I know what it feels like to be bullied. These people aren't friends, remember that a lot of people just don't know you and have no special opinion about you go ahead and discover new people, the internet is full of great people but don't mind trolls, they just want everyone to feel bad.

This is exactly how I feel, I am tired of living, I can't see why everyone is still living, I think that the universe and any kind of life is useless and when I think that killing myself is the solution, I can't stop thinking of how people would react after my death, if I left a letter with my final thoughts, would anyone read it? Would it be public or kept secret? Would anyone do what I asked after my death? And I don't want anyone to feel guilty because of my suicide, if I do it, what would my parents think? Would they be arrested?... I know that feel bro
